scripts.dev:website: npm --prefix website run build && wrangler dev website/dist/server/index.js --port 8788
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config backend/wrangler.toml && npm --prefix website run build && npm --prefix website run validate
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply expenses --local --config backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply expenses --remote --config backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.preview: npm --prefix website run build && node --import tsx scripts/preview.ts
